title: zed-sync write policy v1
description: Canonical enum values for the per-write optimism level, error surface, and conflict resolution. Shared by every language port (JS sdk/src/policy.mjs, Dart lib/src/policy.dart, Rust src/policy.rs) and mirrored by zed-interfaces (SyncWriteMode / SyncErrorPolicy / SyncConflictResolution). zed-sync is the source of truth for these values.

WriteMode.description: local_only: apply locally + enqueue durably, no network until the next flush. optimistic_queue: apply locally, enqueue, send; a send failure leaves the write queued (default). optimistic_await_ack: like optimistic_queue but a send failure is surfaced per the error policy. server_first: send first, apply locally only after the ack. server_only: send only; local state updates when the change feed delivers the committed row.

ErrorPolicy.description: throw_only: reject/throw. emit_only: report via telemetry/onError, settle normally (default for writes). throw_and_emit: both. silent: neither.

ConflictResolution.description: server_wins: adopt the server row and drop the queued local write (default). last_write_wins: keep the higher HLC version, so leaderless multi-master converges deterministically.
